name: Local AI
author: 0xSero
description: Local models and coding agents on your own GPUs, from the Omarchy bar or the optional Local AI tab inside Agents. 77 validated recipes across 37 cards: NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50, RTX Ada, RTX Pro Blackwell, Intel Arc Pro B70 and AMD ROCm. Run several models at once, each on its own GPU group, up to 256K context. Open claude, codex, pi, omp, opencode, crush, grok, copilot or hermes on a running model, nothing written to your config. Share the same keyed endpoint on your tailnet in one click, with live speed, GPU telemetry and today's runtime statistics on the card.

barWidget.description: Local models, coding agents, GPU status and keyed Tailscale sharing, with optional native Agents integration.
